title: Fennec Shand
description: Fennec Shand was a notorious assassin and bounty hunter who worked for all the top syndicates of her time. She found herself in Boba Fett's debt when he saved her life after a losing confrontation with The Mandalorian. Fett delivered her to The Modifier for rehabilitation in a Mos Eisley Mod Parlor, and she later helped Fett as he vied for control of Jabba the Hutt's territory.
